'''March 2002 Dittmer tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Dittmer, Missouri in March 2002. [[Jason Gillman]] won it. It is known from Jason Gillman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3516">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/ Dittmer MO standings (DeckTech report d3516; listed in the archive index)], DeckTech (Jason "3RD EYE" Gillman, 20 March 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' March 2002
* '''Site:''' Dittmer, Missouri
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Jason Gillman]]
